args.body: Take GEOSPATIAL-REQUEST-DELIVERY. The WordPress result exposed a specific mismatch: live website engagements require unavailable customer systems. Test work whose public geographic inputs permit an actual offline deliverable instead. Check public access and inputs before substantial discovery; stop after three requests. Do not create another generic sample or infer paid demand from vendor pricing. Missing submission identity blocks submission only, while missing usable inputs blocks implementation. Preserve all live windows and retirements. Feedback remains unknown; no funds or revenue are verified.

description: The WordPress test found live-system engagements rather than bounded offline work. That narrows that channel, not all paid services. Test public geospatial data work next, requiring a concrete request and usable public inputs before implementation. Feedback remains available but uncertain: 0 classified and 3 unclassified sources establish neither zero demand nor customers.
